description: This file defines a middleware class 'ExpiresParsingMiddleware' used within the AWS SDK for PHP to handle parsing of the 'expires' header in S3 responses. It wraps a handler to log warnings if the 'expires' header fails to be correctly parsed.

classes.name: ExpiresParsingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that logs warnings when the 'expires' header in S3 responses cannot be parsed correctly by checking the headers in the result and triggering a warning if parsing fails.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method that creates a middleware wrapper function, returning a callable that wraps the handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler to invoke.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, calling the next handler, then checking the result for 'Expires' headers and logging a warning if necessary.
